method: Independent current first-screen observation. Reviewer had inherited project history and read the frozen inventory; this is not blinded human usability testing. Fresh isolated reset context per platform, no controls operated before observation; DOM before viewport capture.

web.purpose: The headline and supporting paragraph communicate saving personal material and later searching/asking with a route back to originals.
web.expected_first_action: Import the first material; writing a note is an immediately visible secondary action. Neither action is visually gated by a model/provider setup step.
web.collection_owner: The first screen explicitly says Mac/Android collect on their own devices and Central receives/organizes them. No Central-local folder collection control is shown.
web.density_and_hierarchy: Spacious two-column onboarding, one dominant import action, secondary note and example/source actions. Persistent navigation is separate from the main task.
web.friction_or_uncertainty: Several entry names overlap (top 添加内容/随手记, main import/note, and sidebar shortcuts on Mac); the dominant first action remains clear. “工作台在线” does not by itself explain device connection or authorization.
web.limits: This first screen alone does not prove permission, source configuration, import completion, model optionality across all tasks, or all subsequent newcomer journeys.

android.purpose: The headline and supporting paragraph communicate saving personal material and later searching/asking with a route back to originals.
android.expected_first_action: Import the first material; writing a note is an immediately visible secondary action. Neither action is visually gated by a model/provider setup step.
android.collection_owner: The explanatory section says select scope on this device and later aggregate into Central. The source action is visible in the first viewport, below the main onboarding and example sections.
android.density_and_hierarchy: A single-column reading order keeps purpose and both first actions above the example. Four bottom destinations remain visible; content fits 412px without horizontal overflow.
android.friction_or_uncertainty: Settings and secondary workspaces use an unlabeled three-dot visual affordance (accessible name 更多页面与设置). First import/note actions are explicit, so that does not block the expected start. The small prototype preview toolbar adds visible test-only chrome.
android.limits: This first screen alone does not prove permission, source configuration, import completion, model optionality across all tasks, or all subsequent newcomer journeys.
